question: Does back+left+attack [s,a,space] produce more independently observed pre-deadline kill progress than attack-only [space] under the same 3075 ms owner authority from the original MAP01 fixture and from symmetric 300 ms X11-only left/right setup perturbations recreated fresh in each session?
H: The composite candidate has strictly more sessions with >=1 independent kill-count increase before authority expiry than attack-only in each of original, online-left, and online-right conditions, without more pre-deadline deaths.
T: Nine matched pairs / 18 fresh real ViZDoom 1.3.0 X11 v13 sessions; three pairs per condition. Every session loads the same retained original fixture. Left/right conditions then apply exactly one setup-only 300 ms X11 hold of a/d with a 1500 ms owner deadline and verified-empty completed release before the measured action. Same seed within pair; fixed balanced arm order; measured action uses 3075 ms owner deadline with 5000 ms requested hold; ASYNC_SPECTATOR 35 Hz; skill 1; no model or direct gameplay API action input.

D.PASS_SCOPED_DIRECTION_TRANSFER: candidate pre-deadline progress-success count > baseline in all three states and candidate pre-deadline death count <= baseline in all states; all measurement/source/release gates pass
D.FAIL_FIXED_DIRECTION_GENERALITY: candidate progress-success count < baseline or candidate deaths > baseline in any state
D.HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_DISCRIMINATION: no regression but at least one state ties progress successes
D.FAIL_MEASUREMENT_INTEGRITY: any source closure, verified-empty release, hidden-scorer, terminal-score-agreement, or expected-expiry gate fails; stop at first such case

C: directional geometry may still be local to this MAP01 neighborhood
online perturbations are procedural rather than byte-identical saved states, so asynchronous enemy timing contributes state variation
movement changes line-of-sight as well as evasion
setup action can change enemy evolution before the measured action even though setup progress is excluded by the scorer baseline
U: one host and uncontrolled CPU frequency/scheduling
kill progress is sparse and scorer cadence is finite
left/right conditions are reproducible action procedures, not exact restored world-state bytes
health/ammo are secondary observations, not policy inputs

fixtures.original: retained map01-threat-contact-v2 loaded in all 18 sessions
fixtures.left: online setup procedure: from original, X11-only hold a for 300 ms, require completed verified-empty release, then start measured action
fixtures.right: online setup procedure: from original, X11-only hold d for 300 ms, require completed verified-empty release, then start measured action
